  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "067bd5ef532b91d7f3eb078d02f7dbdc1bce0972d0ed0563aae7cfcce4265218",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"A grid consisting of a measurable partition, an exhaustive nonempty list of distinct directions, coordinate geometry, and strictly ordered lower and upper faces describing each cell region.","effect_on_target":"Restricts the universally quantified grid to this structured class; supplies the direction list used by the schedule.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"Projection of the grid's coordinate-direction structure.","effect_on_target":"Selects the direction enumeration from which the schedule is formed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"A step containing a direction, a real fraction strictly greater than zero and at most one, and a constant-preserving state-update operator.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the type and built-in constraints of schedule entries.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"Projection of a step's direction.","effect_on_target":"Used to require that a schedule entry has each requested direction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"Projection of a step's update-operator structure.","effect_on_target":"Its equality to the method's operator for the selected direction is asserted.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"Projection of a step's real time fraction.","effect_on_target":"Its equality to the method's fraction for the selected direction is asserted.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"A direction-indexed family of constant-preserving update operators and real fractions, with every fraction in (0,1].","effect_on_target":"The theorem quantifies over any such method.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Projection assigning an update-operator structure to each direction.","effect_on_target":"Determines the operator stored in the corresponding scheduled step.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"LocalDef009","meaning":"Projection assigning a real fraction to each direction.","effect_on_target":"Determines the fraction stored in the corresponding scheduled step.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"LocalDef010","meaning":"The inductively generated execution relation: an empty schedule leaves a state unchanged with singleton trace; a leading step advances the initial state before executing the tail and prepends the initial state to its trace.","effect_on_target":"Requires the final state and trace to represent successive execution of the schedule.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"LocalDef011","meaning":"The function space Cell → Value.","effect_on_target":"Initial, final, and intermediate states are arbitrary assignments of values to cells.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"LocalDef012","meaning":"A total function from a real fraction and a state to a state, preserving every constant state for every real fraction.","effect_on_target":"Restricts the operators supplied by the method; supplies the actual state transitions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"LocalDef013","meaning":"Maps the method's step constructor over the supplied direction list in list order.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the schedule exactly, rather than permitting an arbitrary ordering or selection.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"LocalDef014","meaning":"A nonempty finite list of directions with no repetitions and containing every element of Direction.","effect_on_target":"Forces the direction type to be finite and inhabited and ensures exhaustive scheduling.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"LocalDef015","meaning":"Projection of the underlying list from the direction-enumeration structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the ordered list mapped to schedule entries.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"LocalDef016","meaning":"Constructs a grid from a measurable partition, a direction enumeration, coordinate geometry, lower and upper real faces with lower < upper for every cell and direction, and equality of each cell region with its specified coordinate box.","effect_on_target":"Exposes the geometric and partition assumptions carried by a grid.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"LocalDef017","meaning":"Constructs a step from a direction, a real fraction in (0,1], and an update operator.","effect_on_target":"Makes fraction bounds structural requirements of schedule entries.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"LocalDef018","meaning":"For a method and direction, constructs the step using that direction and exactly the method's fraction and operator there.","effect_on_target":"Explains why schedule entries match the method and retain their generating direction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"LocalDef019","meaning":"Constructs a method from a direction-indexed operator family and a direction-indexed real fraction family satisfying 0 < fraction ≤ 1 pointwise.","effect_on_target":"Exposes all requirements on the method; no relation between different directions is required.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"LocalDef020","meaning":"If the remaining steps execute from the state obtained by advancing a leading step, then the full list executes from the original state, with that original state prepended to the tail trace.","effect_on_target":"Encodes sequential application in list order and recording each pre-step state.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"LocalDef021","meaning":"The empty schedule executes from any state to itself with the singleton list containing that state.","effect_on_target":"Ensures the terminal state is recorded and contributes the extra one in trace length.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"LocalDef022","meaning":"Constructs an update operator from A : Real → (Cell → Value) → (Cell → Value), assuming A(r, constant(v)) = constant(v) for every real r and value v.","effect_on_target":"Requires total updates and constant-state preservation, including at fractions outside (0,1].","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"LocalDef023","meaning":"Constructs a direction enumeration from a nonempty list with no duplicates that contains every direction.","effect_on_target":"Excludes empty and infinite direction types from admissible grid instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"LocalDef024","meaning":"Advances a state by applying the step's update operator at the step's fraction.","effect_on_target":"Defines the recurrence governing successive trace states.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"LocalDef025","meaning":"Coordinate geometry given either by equality of Point with Direction → Real or by an equivalence between those types.","effect_on_target":"Restricts points to admit global real coordinates indexed by Direction; supplies the coordinate map defining cells.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"LocalDef026","meaning":"Every method fraction is strictly positive.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the positivity proof when constructing a scheduled step.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"LocalDef027","meaning":"Every method fraction is at most one.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the upper-bound proof when constructing a scheduled step.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"LocalDef028","meaning":"A partition structure containing a domain and measurable cell regions indexed by an inhabited Cell type, pairwise disjoint for distinct indices, whose union is exactly the domain.","effect_on_target":"Places partition and measurability restrictions on the grid input.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"LocalDef029","meaning":"Projection assigning a subset of Point to each cell.","effect_on_target":"The grid requires these sets to equal the specified coordinate boxes.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"LocalDef030","meaning":"The set of points whose coordinate in every listed direction is at least its lower face and strictly less than its upper face.","effect_on_target":"Makes cell regions half-open coordinate boxes; all directions are tested because the list is exhaustive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"LocalDef031","meaning":"Extracts Point ≃ (Direction → Real), using transport for the type-equality case and the supplied equivalence otherwise.","effect_on_target":"Determines the coordinates used in cell-region inequalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"LocalDef032","meaning":"Constructs coordinate geometry from a bijection Point ≃ (Direction → Real).","effect_on_target":"Allows any such bijection without continuity or measurability requirements on it.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"LocalDef033","meaning":"Constructs coordinate geometry from a type equality Point = (Direction → Real).","effect_on_target":"Includes the case where points are directly real coordinate functions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"LocalDef034","meaning":"Constructs a partition from a domain, an inhabited cell index type, measurable cell regions, disjointness for distinct indices, and pointwise equivalence between domain membership and membership in some region.","effect_on_target":"Encodes exact coverage of the chosen domain, not necessarily all points, and does not itself require nonempty regions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"LocalDef035","meaning":"Projection of the real-parameterized state-update function from an operator structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides the function actually called at each scheduled step.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"LocalDef036","meaning":"Dependent case analysis on coordinate geometry with branches for type equality and explicit equivalence.","effect_on_target":"Implements extraction of coordinates without adding a geometric assumption.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"LocalDef037","meaning":"A wrapper around the geometry recursor, passing the equality and equivalence branches.","effect_on_target":"Supports the same two-case coordinate extraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"LocalDef038","meaning":"The eliminator for the two constructors of coordinate geometry.","effect_on_target":"Confirms that coordinate extraction handles exactly the equality and equivalence cases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All five main conclusion clauses, and all properties of each selected step, must hold together.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of objects of the indicated type.","effect_on_target":"Requires exact equality of lists, directions, fractions, operator structures, and natural-number lengths.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification.","effect_on_target":"Quantifies schedule, final state, trace, and a step for each direction with their displayed dependencies.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"The addition operation selected by a heterogeneous-addition instance.","effect_on_target":"Here specializes to natural-number addition in schedule length plus one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"List","meaning":"Finite ordered lists.","effect_on_target":"Schedules and traces have finite length and an order relevant to execution.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"List.instMembership","meaning":"List membership interpreted by List.Mem.","effect_on_target":"A selected step must occur in the schedule; the clause does not explicitly supply its index.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"List.length","meaning":"Number of list entries, zero for the empty list and one plus the tail length for a nonempty list.","effect_on_target":"Counts steps and states in the asserted length equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"List.nil","meaning":"The empty list.","effect_on_target":"Its inequality with the schedule requires at least one step; it also terminates execution.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"MeasurableSpace","meaning":"A measurable-space structure specifying a sigma-algebra on Point.","effect_on_target":"Makes cell-region measurability meaningful; supplies no measure or volume.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"Membership.mem","meaning":"The membership predicate supplied by the relevant container instance.","effect_on_target":"Interprets occurrence in lists and inclusion of points in sets.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers, including zero.","effect_on_target":"The lengths and their equality are natural-number quantities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"Ne","meaning":"Negation of equality.","effect_on_target":"Expresses nonempty lists and distinct cell indices or direction entries.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interpretation of a natural-number literal in its specified type.","effect_on_target":"Interprets one in the trace-length equation and zero and one in real bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Fractions, coordinates, and faces are real-valued.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"instAddNat","meaning":"Natural-number addition instance using Nat.add.","effect_on_target":"Makes the length equation use ordinary natural addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Promotes an addition instance to heterogeneous addition on the same type.","effect_on_target":"Routes the target's addition notation to natural-number addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural-number literal as that natural number itself.","effect_on_target":"The extra length is exactly the natural number one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"List.map","meaning":"Applies a function to every list entry, preserving order and length.","effect_on_target":"Builds one step for each enumerated direction in its existing order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"LE.le","meaning":"The non-strict order relation selected by an instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses fraction upper bounds and included lower coordinate faces using real ≤.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"LT.lt","meaning":"The strict order relation selected by an instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses positive fractions, strict face separation, and excluded upper coordinate faces using real <.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"List.cons","meaning":"Prepends an entry to a list.","effect_on_target":"Builds schedules and execution traces in the inductive clauses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"One.toOfNat1","meaning":"Interprets the numeral one using the type's distinguished one.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real one for fraction upper bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Real.instLE","meaning":"The usual non-strict order on real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Sets the meaning of the fraction upper bound and lower-face inclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Real.instLT","meaning":"The usual strict order on real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Sets the meaning of positivity and strict upper-face exclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real.instOne","meaning":"The real number one as the distinguished multiplicative unit.","effect_on_target":"Provides the constant bounding fractions above.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real number zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the constant below every method and step fraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Set","meaning":"A subset represented by a predicate on its ambient type.","effect_on_target":"Domains, cell regions, and coordinate boxes are predicates on points.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets the numeral zero using the type's distinguished zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real zero in fraction positivity conditions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Coerces a function-like object to its underlying function.","effect_on_target":"Allows evaluation of the coordinate equivalence at a point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"Equiv","meaning":"A bijection given by forward and inverse functions with inverse laws.","effect_on_target":"Requires coordinates to bijectively identify Point with all real direction-indexed tuples.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"Equiv.instEquivLike","meaning":"Uses an equivalence's forward map, inverse map, and inverse laws as an equivalence-like instance.","effect_on_target":"Enables the coordinate equivalence to be evaluated as a function.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"EquivLike.toFunLike","meaning":"Forgets inverse data to obtain the underlying function-like interface.","effect_on_target":"Supports reading coordinates from a point without imposing regularity on the map.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"List.Nodup","meaning":"Pairwise inequality of list entries, hence absence of repetitions.","effect_on_target":"Ensures every direction occurs exactly once in the exhaustive direction list.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"setOf","meaning":"Forms the set defined by a predicate, here identically that predicate.","effect_on_target":"Defines coordinate-box membership by the displayed inequalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"CompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteBooleanAlgebra","meaning":"Forgets atomicity from a complete atomic Boolean algebra.","effect_on_target":"Part of the set-order instance chain used to express disjoint cell regions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteDistribLattice","meaning":"Obtains a complete distributive lattice from a complete Boolean algebra.","effect_on_target":"Carries the set lattice structure toward the order and bottom used by disjointness.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"CompleteBooleanAlgebra.toCompleteLattice","meaning":"Projects the underlying complete lattice.","effect_on_target":"Provides the set lattice in the order instance chain; adds no separate target hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"CompleteDistribLattice.toFrame","meaning":"Projects the underlying frame structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports obtaining the set order's least element for disjointness.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"CompleteLattice.instOmegaCompletePartialOrder","meaning":"Gives a complete lattice an omega-complete partial order using suprema of countable increasing chains.","effect_on_target":"Its underlying partial order is used in the disjointness instance chain; no convergence assertion appears in the target.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"Disjoint","meaning":"Every common lower bound of two elements lies below bottom; for sets, their intersection is empty.","effect_on_target":"Requires cell regions with distinct indices to have no common point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"Equiv.cast","meaning":"The equivalence induced by equality of two types, using transport in each direction.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinates in the geometry constructor based on type equality.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"HeytingAlgebra.toOrderBot","meaning":"Projects the order structure with its least element.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the empty set as bottom in set disjointness.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"Iff","meaning":"Logical equivalence.","effect_on_target":"Requires domain membership exactly when some cell region contains the point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"MeasurableSet","meaning":"Membership of a set in the specified measurable-space sigma-algebra.","effect_on_target":"Requires each partition cell region to be measurable.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"Nonempty","meaning":"Existence of at least one element of a type.","effect_on_target":"Requires the cell index type to be inhabited.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"OmegaCompletePartialOrder.toPartialOrder","meaning":"Projects the underlying partial order.","effect_on_target":"Supplies subset inclusion as the order used for disjointness of sets.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"Order.Frame.toHeytingAlgebra","meaning":"Extracts the Heyting algebra structure of a frame, including its order and bottom.","effect_on_target":"Supports the instance chain interpreting disjointness as empty intersection.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"Set.instCompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra","meaning":"The complete atomic Boolean algebra of subsets, with inclusion order, unions, intersections, complements, and empty-set bottom.","effect_on_target":"Ensures the abstract order-theoretic disjointness condition has its usual set-theoretic meaning.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"Set.instMembership","meaning":"Set membership interpreted as satisfaction of the set's predicate.","effect_on_target":"Interprets points belonging to the domain and cell regions in the partition condition.","status":"understood"}
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify types Cell : Type u_1, Value : Type u_2, and Point and Direction : Type u, and a measurable-space structure on Point.",
      "Universally quantify a grid of type LocalDef001 Cell Point Direction, a method of type LocalDef007 Direction Cell Value, and an initial state u_0 : Cell → Value.",
      "Existentially quantify, in order, a finite list schedule of steps, a final state Cell → Value, and a finite list trace of states. These witnesses may depend on all universally quantified inputs; the later existential witnesses are within the scope of the earlier ones.",
      "Within the conclusion, universally quantify d : Direction and existentially quantify a step s, which may depend on d and the enclosing inputs and witnesses."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The grid contains a domain Ω ⊆ Point and regions R_c ⊆ Point indexed by an inhabited Cell type. Each R_c is measurable, regions with distinct indices are disjoint, and p ∈ Ω if and only if there exists c with p ∈ R_c.",
      "The grid contains a nonempty finite list D = [d_0, ..., d_(n-1)] with no duplicates and containing every element of Direction.",
      "The grid's geometry supplies a bijection χ : Point ≃ (Direction → Real), either directly or by an equality of these types.",
      "For every c : Cell and d : Direction, the grid supplies real faces ℓ_c(d) < h_c(d), and R_c is exactly {p | for every d in D, ℓ_c(d) ≤ χ(p)(d) < h_c(d)}.",
      "The method supplies for each direction d an operator structure with underlying total map A_d : Real → (Cell → Value) → (Cell → Value), satisfying A_d(r, constant(v)) = constant(v) for every real r and v : Value.",
      "The method supplies fractions τ_d ∈ Real satisfying 0 < τ_d ≤ 1 for every direction d.",
      "The initial state is an arbitrary function Cell → Value. There are no further separately stated hypotheses."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The schedule equals the list obtained by mapping d ↦ the step containing d, τ_d, its bound proofs, and the method's operator structure at d over D, preserving order.",
      "The schedule is nonempty.",
      "For every direction d, there exists a step s occurring in the schedule such that s.direction = d, s.timeFraction = τ_d, and s.oneDimensionalSolve equals the method's operator structure at d.",
      "The schedule, initial state, final state, and trace satisfy the execution relation LocalDef010.",
      "The natural-number length of trace equals the length of schedule plus one."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "A state is a function Cell → Value; constant(v) denotes the function assigning v to every cell.",
      "A step consists of a direction d, a fraction r with 0 < r ≤ 1, and a total constant-preserving update operator A. Its advance on state u is A(r,u).",
      "The execution relation has base case Exec([],u,u,[u]). Its inductive case is: if Exec(S,advance(s,u),v,T), then Exec(s::S,u,v,u::T).",
      "Equivalently, for schedule [s_0,...,s_(n-1)], execution means trace = [u_0,...,u_n], where u_0 is initialState, u_(i+1) = advance(s_i,u_i) for every natural index 0 ≤ i < n, and u_n is finalState.",
      "For the required schedule, the recurrence becomes u_(i+1) = A_(d_i)(τ_(d_i),u_i). The direction list has n ≥ 1 entries and enumerates Direction exactly once."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every measurable point space, grid, method, and initial cell-value assignment satisfying the structural conditions above, there exist a schedule, a final assignment, and a trace such that the schedule is exactly the method's steps in the grid's direction-list order, is nonempty, and contains for each direction a step with exactly that direction's prescribed fraction and operator. The trace records the initial assignment and every successive assignment obtained by applying these operators at their prescribed fractions in that order, ending at the final assignment. If the schedule has n steps, the trace has exactly n+1 states."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "Although the type binders are unrestricted syntactically, supplying a grid forces Direction to be finite and inhabited, Cell to be inhabited, and Point to admit a bijection with Direction → Real. For types admitting no such grid, the universal assertion over grids is vacuous.",
    "Supplying the initial state together with an inhabited Cell forces Value to be inhabited. If Value is empty, there is no admissible initial-state input.",
    "The partition constructor alone allows empty regions, but the full grid conditions imply each region is nonempty: its strictly ordered faces give a coordinate tuple inside the box, and the coordinate map is surjective. Consequently the grid domain is also nonempty.",
    "There is no assumption that Cell is finite or that the domain equals all of Point. No measure, cell volume, integration, or definition of an actual cell average is supplied.",
    "The coordinate equivalence need not be continuous, differentiable, linear, or measurable. The encoded geometric condition is a half-open box condition in the chosen coordinates, together with measurability of the resulting cell regions.",
    "The update operators are arbitrary total functions subject to constant-state preservation. Their names do not encode a differential equation, a one-dimensional domain, locality along a direction, numerical consistency, conservation, stability, or accuracy.",
    "Fractions are individually in (0,1]; no sum-to-one condition, common time increment, or relation between fractions in different directions is imposed.",
    "The operators preserve constant states for every real fraction, not merely scheduled fractions in (0,1]. No algebraic or topological structure on Value is required.",
    "The schedule uses each direction exactly once as a consequence of the mapped exhaustive duplicate-free list. Its order is fixed by the input grid; no order-independence or commutation assertion is made.",
    "The result asserts existence, not an explicit uniqueness clause or a computational complexity bound. The execution relation nevertheless determines the intermediate and final states for a fixed schedule and initial state.",
    "There is no comparison with an exact solution or any approximation-error conclusion. The asserted execution is finite iteration of already supplied total functions."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
